in_sanskrit.name: कृष्णान
in_sanskrit.meaning: God Krishna, or one who is all-attractive
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: कृ (Krish) + ष्ण (Shana) = कृष्णान (Krushana) Means 'God Krishna' or 'one who is all-attractive'

in_marathi.name: Krushana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krushana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Krush’, meaning to delight or to please. The name Krushana is a variation of Krishna, the eighth avatar of the Hindu god Vishnu, who is known for his mischievous yet loving demeanor and his delight in his devotees.
